== Rules == 
* '''Cup:''' Clans will be seeded and placed in a playoff tree. All games are BO5. 

* '''Match procedure:''' First map pick decided by cmd rnd. Second map is picked by the clan who didnt pick first. If 1-1, first picker pick again. If 2-0, losing clan picks 3rd. If 2-1, losing clan picks 4th. If 2-2, cmd rnd who toss first. The randomly selected clan toss one of the remaining three maps, the other clan toss one of the now remaining two maps. Play the last remaining map. No map can be played twice.

* '''Maps:''' DM2, DM3, E1M2, SCHLOSS, PHANTOMABASE, CTL8, STRONGHOLD_FINAL

* '''Server settings:''' Standard settings set by command /4on4

* '''Reporting:''' Report the game with screenshots in #eqlcup-reports on qlanwars discord

* '''Clans and players:''' State your lineup when signing up. It is ok for a player to play in more than one clan as long as the clans are not in the same division.
